title: 'Abasa 80:34-42 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: 'Abasa 80:34-42 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ (٣٤) وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ (٣٥) وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ (٣٦) لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ (٣٧) وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ (٣٨) ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ (٣٩) وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ (٤٠) تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ (٤١) أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ (٤٢)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: On the Day a man will flee from his brother And his mother and his father
And his wife and his children, For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
[Some] faces, that Day, will be bright - Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust. Blackness will cover them.
Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

questions.q: Chunk and link 'Abasa 80:34-42 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 80:34-42 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 80:34-42 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, contrast the two groups of faces in 80:38 to 42.
questions.a: Bright and joyful (believers) against dust-covered and darkened (the disbelieving, wicked).
All 42 ayat with no more than three prompts.
A) bright, laughing and rejoicing. 80:38 to 39: bright, laughing, rejoicing. Dust is on the other faces (80:40).

questions.q: Think again: On the Day of Judgement a person runs from his brother, mother, father, wife and children (80:34 to 36). Why would anyone run from the people they love most?
questions.a: Each person will be busy with their own matter that Day (80:37). Only faith and good deeds help.
